prompt: Some people believe that newspapers and websites should be free to publish stories about the private lives of famous people. Others think that famous people have the same right to privacy as anyone else. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Nowadays, newspapers and websites often publish stories about private life of famous people, such as actors, singers and politicians. Some people think this is acceptable, while other people think that famous people also need privacy. This essay will discuss both views and give my own opinion.

On the one hand, some people believe that famous people have no right to complain about the media. They became famous by their own choice and they earn a lot of money because of the public attention. For example, many celebrities use social media to show their life to the fans, so it is not fair if they want the attention only when it is good for them. Also, the people want to know about their favourite stars, and these stories help the newspapers to sell more copies.

On the other hand, other people argue that famous people are also human and they deserve privacy like everyone else. When the journalists follow them everywhere and take photos of their children, it causes a lot of stress for them and their family. In some cases, the famous people even got depression because of the pressure from media. Some photographers also chase them in cars, which is very dangerous. Furthermore, the children of celebrities did not choose to be famous, so their privacy must be protected.

In my opinion, famous people should accept that the media will report about their life, because this is the price of the fame and they get many benefits from it. However, the newspapers should not publish the stories which are completely false or which harm the children. Therefore, there should be some rules to control the media, so that both the famous people and the public are satisfied.
title: Reporting on the private lives of the famous
